b9586d8e730cfb0d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة العرب العصري الطبي عن مدخل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على مراجعة استمارات البيانات وتدقيقها، بالإضافة إلى إدخال وتخزين المعلومات باستخدام أنظمة الحاسب الآلي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة الاستمارات المتعلقة بالبيانات وترميزها والتأكد من اكتمالها ودقتها. إدخال البيانات والمعلومات في الحاسب الآلي وفقاً للبرامج والنظم الإحصائية المعتمدة. مراجعة رموز التصنيف للبيانات والمعلومات المدخلة وتصويب أي أخطاء قد تظهر فيها. تخزين المعلومات المدخلة بطريقة منظمة وآمنة. عمل النسخ الاحتياطية اللازمة للبيانات والمعلومات المخزنة لضمان سلامتها. التقيد الصارم بالتعليمات والإجراءات المتعلقة بسرية البيانات والمعلومات وحمايتها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدخال البيانات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على مراجعة وتدقيق البيانات بدقة عالية. معرفة جيدة باستخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج إدخال البيانات. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالسرية التامة للمعلومات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الطائف، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة تركز على دقة البيانات وسريتها. التقديم لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. يمكن للمرشحين المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه تقديم طلباتهم.

b9584b335dec7237.description: About the Role Aviagen is seeking a Health Safety & Environment (HSE) Engineer to support the implementation and monitoring of HSE requirements across project sites in Sakaka, Dawmat Al Jandal, and Miguwa within the Al Jawf Region of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and involves close collaboration with Project Management and site teams to ensure safe project delivery. Key Responsibilities Implement and monitor the Project HSE Plan, adhering to Saudi HSE and Civil Defense requirements. Conduct regular site inspections to identify unsafe acts, conditions, and non-conformities, tracking and verifying corrective actions. Monitor the safe execution of high-risk activities, including excavation, work at height, lifting operations, electrical works, hot work, and confined space activities. Oversee the Permit-to-Work (PTW) system, ensuring proper procedures, risk assessments, and controls are in place. Monitor fire prevention and protection arrangements, emergency preparedness, and participate in emergency drills. Address occupational health risks such as heat stress, dust, noise, and chemical exposure, ensuring proper PPE use and welfare facilities. Conduct site HSE inductions, Toolbox Talks, and maintain training and competency records. Monitor contractor and subcontractor compliance with project HSE requirements, reviewing documentation and conducting inspections. Report incidents and near misses, participate in investigations, identify causes, and contribute to corrective actions and lessons learned. Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly HSE reports, observation registers, and incident records. Authority and Accountability The HSE Engineer is accountable for hazard identification, risk prevention, and ensuring compliance with applicable Saudi regulations and project procedures. This role involves escalating serious or imminent hazards to Project Management and exercising or recommending Stop Work Authority in accordance with the approved project authority matrix. The incumbent will maintain professional independence and provide accurate factual reporting of HSE issues, escalating unresolved violations through established management processes. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in Health, Safety & Environment roles. Demonstrated ability to implement and monitor HSE requirements on project sites. Proficiency in hazard identification, risk assessment, and incident management. Strong understanding of Saudi HSE and Civil Defense regulations. Experience with high-risk activity monitoring and Permit-to-Work systems. Work Environment and Travel This is a field-based role requiring regular presence at remote project locations in Sakaka, Dawmat Al Jandal, and Miguwa within the Al Jawf Region. Frequent travel between project sites will be necessary. The role involves exposure to construction, agricultural, industrial, and infrastructure project environments, combining field inspections, safety monitoring, and office-based reporting. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

The role involves new business development, account support, order coordination, and in-market activations. Candidates should have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities New Business & Account Development (40%): Identify potential pharmacies, stockists, venues, and partners in Riyadh. Build relationships with key decision-makers and support new listings through outreach, follow-ups, and negotiations. Conduct regular field visits to prospective and existing partners. Partner Execution & In-Market Visibility (30%): Maintain strong relationships with existing pharmacies, B2B, and retail partners. Support promotions, sampling, and activation initiatives. Coordinate with finance and operations teams to ensure timely order fulfillment. Follow up on outstanding payments and support account administration. b9bf120c4db269f3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الموئل للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ وتطوير التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد برامج التشغيل والصيانة للمعدات الصناعية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الأعمال الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، مع الالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. فهم قوي لمبادئ التصميم الميكانيكي وتطبيقاته. القدرة على إعداد المخططات الفنية وبرامج التشغيل والصيانة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة الموئل للاستشارات الهندسية في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب. عن شركة الموئل للاستشارات الهندسية تلتزم شركة الموئل للاستشارات الهندسية بتقديم حلول هندسية متكاملة، وتسعى لضم الكفاءات التي تساهم في تحقيق أهدافها وتطوير مشاريعها. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين الميكانيكيين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في الظهران.

b9678fc2acca0f5a.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، ومباشرة تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع جداول زمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف للتأكد من دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. القدرة على التعامل مع وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. فهم جيد لمعايير الجودة والصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل تتمركز هذه الوظيفة في مدينة حائل، وهي وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات. يتوقع من شاغل الوظيفة العمل بفعالية ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

b97902563fd1d291.description: About the Role Napco National is seeking a Merchandiser to join their team in Arar, Northern Frontier. This is a full-time position suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Ensure shelves and warehouses are free of damaged or dirty products, returning defective items weekly with official customer return documentation as needed. Verify quantities of returned items in Key Account warehouses/outlets to manage discrepancies. Organize Napco products in the warehouse, maintaining their good condition and cleanliness. Coordinate with drivers to facilitate timely deliveries. Confirm the presence of all company products (all sizes and packaging) on shelves. Implement sales planograms and maintain shelves according to shelf rent agreements. Ensure accuracy of shelf prices. b9e863691e38d887.description: About the role This is an entry-level web development role inside a strategy advisory firm, and it exists because the firm's own web presence and internal tools are worked on by people who also have client mandates to run. You would carry the day-to-day build and upkeep of those properties from your first week: the site, the pages we publish for the markets we work in, and the small internal tools that principals and analysts use to get their work done. The scope is practical rather than theoretical, and you would own finished work rather than fragments of someone else's project. About Namaa Partners Namaa Partners is a strategy advisory firm based in Riyadh, working mostly with organizations in Saudi Arabia and with companies that have significant interests there. We advise family groups and their holding companies, listed corporations, private equity portfolio companies, banks and insurers, government entities, and industrial operators. The work covers corporate strategy, growth and market entry, operating model and efficiency, organization and talent, digital strategy, performance improvement, and governance and risk. Engagements are scoped by the principals who then deliver them, and they often continue past the recommendation into board meetings and the testing of management plans. What you will do Build and maintain the firm's public website, including new pages, content updates, and the fixes that keep a live site working properly. Turn material from principals into clean, readable web pages and documents, matching the firm's own tone rather than a template. Maintain the small internal tools the team relies on, such as a dashboard of live engagements or a shared library of published research. Test pages across browsers and screen sizes, and resolve layout and performance issues as they come up. Write down what you built and how it is maintained, so the next person can pick it up without asking you. Work with whoever is scoping a piece of the site, ask what the page needs to do, and come back with something that does it. What we need from you Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, whether from a degree, a course, or projects you built yourself. Some experience with a modern framework or content management system, and a clear account of what you did in it. Care for how a page reads as well as how it renders: spacing, hierarchy, and text that a client can follow. Comfort working from a short written brief, and asking questions early when the brief is thin. Written and spoken English at a professional level. Arabic is useful for reviewing content, but not required. An interest in how organizations in the Kingdom actually operate, since the site speaks to the people we advise. What success looks like Within six to twelve months, the site should be something principals can point a client to without checking it first. Requests for a new page or a correction should reach you and come back done, without a chase. The internal tools should be used daily by people who would notice if they stopped working. You would also have a record of a few things you fixed that no one asked about, because you saw them and dealt with them. How decisions get made Principals scope the work and decide what the firm publishes, so you would get a brief rather than a ticket queue. You own the build, the sequence of it, and the technical choices inside it, and you would be expected to say when a request will take longer than the person asking assumes. Anything that touches how the firm presents itself to a client goes to the principal who owns that relationship. Escalation is direct: you raise it with the person who scoped it, and if that stalls, it goes to a partner. What the role offers This is a permanent, full-time position, hybrid, based in Riyadh. You would see how an advisory firm presents its thinking to boards and management teams, and how that thinking changes once a decision is made. The web work is real and it is used, and the people reviewing it read closely. You would work alongside principals and analysts rather than in a separate technology function. Who tends to do well here People who write clearly and would rather cut a paragraph than add one. People who can work in a client's own vocabulary without needing a formal specification to begin. People who are comfortable being accountable for a number, a deadline, or a page that has to be right when a principal sends the link. The role suits someone early in their career who wants to see the decision behind the work, not only the ticket in front of them.

b981a36e0718d459.description: Overview As a Product Manager at Four Principles, you will own the vision, backlog, and delivery of the digital products we build for our clients across government, semi-government, and private sectors. You will be the bridge between client stakeholders and our delivery team, making sure that what gets built solves the right problem. Working closely with solution architects, UI/UX designers, developers, and QA engineers, you will turn business needs into a clear, prioritized backlog and guide each release from discovery to adoption, ensuring every increment delivers measurable value to the client. Key Responsibilities Define and communicate the product vision, roadmap, and release plan in line with the client's strategic and digital transformation objectives. Own, refine, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, user needs, risk, and technical dependencies. Translate business requirements into clear epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that the delivery team can estimate and build. Act as the main point of contact between client stakeholders and the delivery team, running workshops, demos, and steering updates. Lead Agile ceremonies with the Scrum Master, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Work with the Solution Architect and UI/UX Designer to ensure solutions are feasible, user-centered, and aligned with architecture standards. Define product KPIs and success metrics, track them after go-live, and use the data to drive the next round of improvements. Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) and accept or reject completed work against agreed acceptance criteria. Manage scope, timelines, and trade-offs, escalating risks and dependencies early with clear options and recommendations. Produce and maintain product documentation, including requirements, release notes, and user guides, to support handover and adoption. Contribute to FP's proposals and pre-sales work by shaping digital product scope, estimates, and delivery approaches. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in digital product delivery, with at least 3 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager on web or mobile platforms. Proven experience owning a product backlog and writing user stories and acceptance criteria within Agile/Scrum teams. Experience working directly with senior client or business stakeholders and managing competing priorities. Hands-on experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar backlog tools, plus Confluence and Figma or equivalent. Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, APIs, and system integrations, enough to discuss trade-offs with engineers. Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to present to both technical and non-technical audiences.

b9d5062abf372561.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن وسيط سلع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى وسيط السلع مسؤولية شراء وبيع السلع المادية ومشتقاتها نيابة عن المستثمرين، وتقديم التوصيات بشأن صفقات التداول والأوراق المالية الجذابة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات اللازمة لإجراء التحليلات المالية، بما في ذلك تطورات الأسعار وتوقعات الطلب واتجاهات الاقتصاد الكلي، وفهم احتياجات ومتطلبات الاستثمار. إجراء التحليلات المالية، وإنشاء النماذج المالية، وتحديد الاتجاهات، وبلورة التصورات، وتحديد فرص الاستثمار والمراجحة. شراء وبيع السلع المادية ومشتقاتها، مثل المستقبليات والعقود الآجلة، بما يتناسب مع تفويض المستثمر، وضمان معالجة الصفقات بشكل صحيح. تقديم التوصيات حول صفقات التداول التنافسية والسلع والمشتقات الجذابة. تنسيق الخدمات اللوجستية المتعلقة بشراء وبيع السلع المادية، والتواصل مع مقدمي خدمات النقل والشحن والتأمين وغيرها من الخدمات ذات الصلة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد لأسواق السلع والمشتقات. القدرة على إجراء التحليلات المالية وإنشاء النماذج. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على تفسير البيانات المالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم التوصيات والتنسيق مع الأطراف المختلفة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق وفي بيئة سريعة الوتيرة. بيئة العمل يقع هذا الدور في مدينة الرياض، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة معين للموارد البشرية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

b9901cc06f384f73.description: Job Purpose HanmiGlobal is seeking a highly qualified Road Inspector to join our program management and PMCM team in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will carry out field inspection and quality surveillance of roadworks and highway infrastructure construction for a mega multi-work package land and infrastructure development program in Riyadh, delivered on behalf of a major government entity. Key Responsibilities You will monitor contractor compliance with approved design drawings, technical specifications, safety standards, and quality control procedures for roads, pavements, and associated infrastructure, ensuring works are constructed to the required standards and supporting the successful delivery of the overall development program. • Conduct daily field inspections of road and highway construction activities — subgrade, subbase, base course, asphalt paving, kerbs and channels, drainage, road markings, and signage — to verify compliance with approved drawings and technical specifications. • Monitor and verify the contractor's material sampling and testing procedures for soil, aggregate, and asphalt in accordance with approved standards (e.g., ASTM, AASHTO, or applicable Saudi standards). • Review and verify survey and setting-out data for roadworks to confirm alignment, levels, and geometrics conform to the approved design. • Identify and report non-conformances, defects, and deviations from specifications; b9809e7f36641ff5.job_title: Manager-Internal Audit & Risk Management- Saudi Nationals
b9809e7f36641ff5.description: Aljomaih Energy and Water Company (AEW) develops, invests in, owns and operates conventional power generation, renewable power and water desalination assets in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the wider region largely through project-specific special purpose vehicles (SPVs) and joint ventures with domestic and international partners. The Internal Audit & Risk Management function provides independent and objective assurance and advisory services designed to add value and improve AEW's operations. The function reports functionally to the Board Audit Committee and administratively to the Chief Executive Officer. This role supports the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management across corporate functions, project companies and joint venture entities and is expected to operate credibly with senior management, external auditors, regulators, lenders and shareholder representatives. Overview The Manager, Internal Audit & Risk Management plays a critical role in upholding AEW's ethical, governance and operational integrity. The role plans and executes risk-based internal audits, supports the design and operation of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, and advises management on effective risk mitigation and control improvement. The role requires a proactive mindset, strong analytical and report-writing skills, sound judgement in sensitive situations and a working understanding of the utilities development industry - in particular conventional power, renewable power and water projects and the contractual and financing structures through which they are delivered. Your Job Functions (Duties & Responsibilities) Internal Audit Plan & Execute: Support the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management in developing the annual risk-based internal audit plan and independently manage and execute internal audits engagement within your assigned area of responsibility. Evaluate & Improve: Conduct comprehensive audits of various business functions, processes and controls, evaluating their effectiveness and identifying areas for improvement. Compliance & Reporting: Assess compliance with relevant laws, regulations and company policies, and prepare clear and concise audit reports that communicate findings, recommendations and remediation plans to senior management and the Board Audit Committee. Follow-up & Monitoring: Monitor and track the implementation of agreed-upon audit recommendations, ensuring timely and effective resolution of identified issues. Policies and Procedures Review: Assist in the review and improvement of company-wide policies, procedures, and management practices. Project, Contract and Capital Expenditure Audits Audit the project development lifecycle from origination and bid through to financial close, construction, commissioning and handover to operations. Contract Assurance: Review compliance with EPC, O&M, PPA/WPA, shareholder and financing agreements, including obligations, milestones, liquidated damages, warranties, insurance and reporting covenants. Capex & Claims: Verify progress payments, variation orders, claims, change management and contingency utilization against contractual entitlement and approved budgets. SPV & JV Governance: Assess governance, delegation of authority and control arrangements at project companies and joint ventures, including access rights available to AEW under shareholder agreements. Risk Management Plan & Execute: Support the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management in developing the annual plan to support, manage and execute risk management engagements within your assigned area of responsibility ERM Framework: Collaborate with the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management and senior management to develop, implement & maintain the company's ERM framework, encompassing risk identification, assessment, mitigation and monitoring processes. Risk Assessment & Mitigation: Conduct regular risk assessments to identify and evaluate potential risks facing the company, considering likelihood, impact and cascading effects. Develop and implement effective risk mitigation plans aligned with the overall ERM strategy and internal controls framework. Risk Communication & Monitoring: Maintain an updated risk register and ensure consistent communication of risks to relevant stakeholders. Integrate risk management activities with internal audit processes. Emerging Risks: Analyze emerging risks and trends, proactively adapt the ERM framework and annual plans to address them. Advisory and Ad hoc Engagement Ensure the smooth and effective execution of all Ad hoc or advisory engagements once assigned within expected turnaround time and quality of deliverables. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Engineering or a related discipline. Master's degree or MBA preferred. Eight to ten years of relevant professional experience, of which a minimum of four to five years in internal audit, risk management or external audit. Experience with a Big Four firm, leading professional services firm or similar industry is preferred. Demonstrated exposure to IPP/IWP structures, project SPVs, joint ventures, EPC and O&M contracts and project finance is strongly preferred. Track record of reporting to, or presenting at, an Audit Committee or equivalent governance forum. Certifications Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) required or actively pursuing with completion within an agreed timeframe. One or more of the following is preferred: SOCPA, CPA, ACCA, CRMA, CFE, CISA or PMP. ISO 31000 risk management training is an advantage. COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework (2013) and COSO Enterprise Risk Management - Integrating with Strategy and Performance (2017). Understanding of NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls, Saudi Companies Law, applicable corporate governance regulations, ZATCA requirements and IFRS as endorsed in Saudi Arabia.
